mapper.sql: c.id, c.tenant_id AS tenantId, c.conv_type AS convType, c.name, c.avatar, c.owner_id AS ownerId, c.last_message_id AS lastMessageId, c.last_message_at AS lastMessageAt, c.member_count AS memberCount, c.created_at AS createdAt, m.id AS memberId, m.pinned, m.muted, m.unread_count AS unreadCount, m.last_read_id AS lastReadId, m.role AS memberRole, m.nickname AS memberNickname, pu.id AS peerUserId, COALESCE(pu.real_name, pu.username) AS peerName, pu.avatar_url AS peerAvatar, lm.msg_type AS lastMessageType, lm.content AS lastMessageContent, lm.sender_id AS lastMessageSenderId, COALESCE(lu.real_name, lu.username) AS lastMessageSenderName, lm.recalled AS lastMessageRecalled

FROM chat_conversation c INNER JOIN chat_conversation_member m ON m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN chat_conversation_member pm ON pm.conversation_id = c.id AND pm.user_id <> #{userId} AND c.conv_type = 'SINGLE' AND IFNULL(pm.deleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pu.id = pm.user_id LEFT JOIN chat_message lm ON lm.id = c.last_message_id AND IFNULL(lm.deleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user lu ON lu.id = lm.sender_id
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_conversation c INNER JOIN chat_conversation_member m ON m.conversation_id = c.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND IFNULL(m.deleted, 0) = 0 AND m.quit_at IS NULL AND IFNULL(c.deleted, 0) = 0
AND c.conv_type = #{convType}
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND m.unread_count > 0

SELECT
WHERE c.id = #{conversationId} AND IFNULL(m.deleted, 0) = 0 AND m.quit_at IS NULL AND IFNULL(c.deleted, 0) = 0 LIMIT 1
